Dead-end streets, including cul-de-sac streets, shall not exceed 300 feet in length and shall not serve more than 30 dwelling units. The developer's financial guarantee may be any of the following: (1) An escrow of funds with the county; (2) An escrow of funds with a bank upon which the county can draw; (3) An irrevocable letter of credit or commitment upon which the county can draw; (4) A performance bond for the benefit of the county upon which the county can collect; and (5) Any other form of guarantee approved by the board of commissioners that will satisfy the objectives of this subsection. The guarantee shall be in an amount sufficient to secure the full costs, as determined by the Town of Carl Director of Public Works, of the construction cost of the improvements, based on the most recent edition of Georgia Department of Transportation "Item Means Summary" or other comparable standardized cost estimation procedure.
